articles.title: Atari Announces Strategic IP Agreement With Ubisoft To Revive Five Acclaimed Titles
articles.summary: NEW YORK, August 26, 2025--Atari acquired all IP rights for five Ubisoft titles on new platforms, including Cold Fear, I Am Alive, Child of Eden, Grow Home, and Grow Up.
